notes: Classifications for every descriptor in OpenClaw's core and sub-CLI catalogs. The generated cli-parity.json preserves descriptor order and rejects missing or stale classifications.

crestodian.rationale: Hidden deprecated OpenClaw setup alias; it has no Metiq equivalent.

claws.rationale: Experimental OpenClaw Claws are an OpenClaw-specific package concept and are not exposed as a Metiq command group.

dashboard.rationale: Control UI launch and token handoff are OpenClaw-specific; Metiq serves its Web UI from the daemon.

reset.rationale: Destructive local reset UX is intentionally outside Metiq's command surface.

uninstall.rationale: Packaging/service uninstall remains platform-owned rather than a Metiq CLI command.

agent.rationale: Metiq currently exposes agent management through the plural agents group, not a singular local-turn command.

audit.rationale: Metiq has security and task audit surfaces but no equivalent top-level lifecycle audit browser.

gateway.rationale: Metiq names the generic gateway passthrough group gw; daemon lifecycle remains a separate daemon group.

promos.rationale: ClawHub promotional-offer discovery is OpenClaw marketplace infrastructure.

infer.rationale: Metiq has provider/model management but no stable top-level inference command group.

capability.rationale: OpenClaw infer alias; no corresponding Metiq command is present.

exec-approvals.rationale: OpenClaw alias; Metiq exposes the same operator area as approvals.

devices.rationale: Metiq exposes device operations through gateway/node management rather than a dedicated top-level device-auth CLI.

users.rationale: OpenClaw durable local users/email aliases differ from Metiq's Nostr identity model.

node.rationale: OpenClaw node runs a headless node-host service; Metiq's node alias manages remote nodes and is not semantically equivalent.

worker.rationale: OpenClaw's restricted cloud-worker runtime is not a Metiq local CLI responsibility.

fleet.rationale: OpenClaw tenant-cell fleet provisioning differs from Metiq's Nostr-native agent and Soul Factory lifecycle.

worktrees.rationale: Managed worktree lifecycle is deferred with the WS-A/A7 workspace surface.

attach.rationale: Claude Code session attachment is deferred until the protocol-v4 session surface is established.

tui.rationale: OpenClaw's terminal UI is a separate interactive client subsystem.

terminal.rationale: OpenClaw alias for its local TUI; Metiq does not expose that client.

chat.rationale: OpenClaw local terminal chat UI is not the Metiq Web UI or gateway chat API.

dns.rationale: OpenClaw DNS discovery helpers are not present as a Metiq command group.

docs.rationale: Live OpenClaw documentation search is project-specific infrastructure.

proxy.rationale: OpenClaw's debug proxy and capture browser have no Metiq equivalent.

webhooks.rationale: Webhook helper configuration is not exposed as a Metiq top-level group.

clawbot.rationale: Legacy OpenClaw aliases do not apply to Metiq.

pairing.rationale: Secure DM pairing is handled by Metiq's Nostr-native trust/routing model rather than an OpenClaw pairing CLI.

directory.rationale: OpenClaw channel contact/group lookup is not a Metiq top-level command.
